title: Approve the Brass Aneroid layout
question: Three layouts in the same brass world. Pick the one to build, and use the steer box to say what to carry over from the others or what feels false.

options.label: A · PSI Leads
options.thesis: PSI owns the dial with a full sweep and needle; AQI is a sub-dial at six o'clock; regional PSIs are engraved on the bezel.
options.viewport: PSI needle and counter are the hero; AQI reads second; regions ring the bezel.
options.risk: AQI is clearly secondary, and the main counter is small for an exact-numbers-first product. The needle sits at about 190, not 183 (a comp defect, fixed in code).

options.label: B · Twin Scales
options.thesis: Both sources get equal weight: concentric PSI and AQI arcs, two needles on one hub, two counters side by side.
options.viewport: Two arcs up top, PSI 183 and AQI 168 in matching counters below.
options.risk: Two scales on a 170pt face is the densest option, and the regional readings are gone.

options.label: C · Counter First (night)
options.thesis: The exact number is the hero in a wide roller counter; the needle arc shrinks to a band indicator. Shown in dark mode with radium lume.
options.viewport: A big 183 across the middle, AQI 168 counter beneath, shallow band arc above.
options.risk: Least like a classic barometer; the needle becomes supporting cast. Day mode would use the silver dial.
